title: the traitors us episodes 4 + 5. am I glad I kept watching???? #thetra...
transcript: Let's watch the traitors episodes 4 and 5 if you haven't watched week 2 yet. Swipe away, giving you one more second. Another brutal boot order for me. He lost Tiffany to banishment and the traitors did away with Monet. Sucks. Terrible. So sad. Tiffany especially. Someone I love so much from big brother, from the challenge. She's so smart, she's so strategic. She just understands these games and people so well. But she's also just like, a really big personality, which is unfortunately a terrible combo for the traitors because people are going to target you for just being intelligent. It's truly such a bummer. And I love Monet, and I feel like we did not get enough. I know this is the game. It's just. It. It sucks. That being said, it was almost worth it because we finally got to get rid of this man. I just cannot with him in every way. Episode 5 Round Table was uncomfortable to watch. It made me like viscerally feel icky. I don't know if he intended to imply that, like, Colton was a liar for not coming out of the closet, but it definitely felt that way. It felt really gross, and I'm not sad to see him go, and I hope it's an improvement for the entire castle. I thought the way that Michael treated Colton in the round table was disgusting. I also would really like Colton out of the castle. You know, the history of him And Cassie. I don't love the way he speaks about people. I sometimes find his, like, intensity a little bit off putting. I feel like enough people think he's a traitor that we'll probably get him out soon. But like, next episode would be great for me. I really wish Rob Sesterino was here. I also lost Caroline in this episode. I have nothing really to say about that except that I really enjoyed watching Lisa, her, and Candace talk to each other. I will say, overall, as much as I was like, anti these being our traitors, I am fairly impressed with the three of them. I kind of have become a Rob fan, which I was not expecting. Candice and Lisa are both, like, very smart, very savvy players. I do think there's a reason that multiple people are catching on to Lisa as being a traitor, and it is because I think she's playing really quiet. You need to do more of her, like, Real Housewives thing to get people off her trail, actually. And I hope the three of them are smart enough not to target Holton tonight, because there's a very good chance he's either safe because he took a shield, or safe because no one stole a shield. And I feel like it paints such a huge target on Lisa if they do. I do actually feel great about my girl Natalie. People seem to like her. She's not afraid to, like, speak up. She's also not going after anyone directly. She seems to have good relationships in the castle, but I don't think she's like on the radar of the traitors either, so I don't know. I feel like she could go pretty far. I will always root for Natalie Anderson. Starting next week, we only get one episode per week until February 26th. If I had to guess, the traitors don't remove anyone from the game next week and Ron goes home. Which is a bummer cause I actually really like Ron and I hope he like, isn't therapy after this because this feels like a really intense experience. Also next week they showed us a challenge is cabin in the Woods and I love that one cause it's just like, fun to watch them all scream. We know if you want me to talk about anything else in detail, but otherwise it was like, two fairly interesting episodes and I'm. I'm glad I kept watching.
